messages:
miriam_cs: Heads-up — Tethys dedicated capacity bring-up tomorrow 08:00 PST. Need final confirmation on quota, autoscale knobs, and load-test window. TL;DR: 2 reserved pools (pool-A: 4xA10G, pool-B: 2xA10G), target sustained QPS ~1.5k, planned burst to 6k for up to 5m. Who owns runbook + post-test quiet window?

devon_ml: Got it. Can we confirm model variants + fallback? They plan redwood/gpt-medium-v1 (fp16) primary, fallback to v1-q4 if latency spikes. Also: do we want KV-cache priming or cold-start sim? @pranav_sre need your input on cache priming.

pranav_sre: I can own autoscale config. Proposal: pool-A min_nodes=2, max_nodes=8, scale_step=1, cooldown=60s. For pool-B keep min=1 max=3. Recommend prefill KV cache with top-100 queries (run as a separate job 45m prior). Circuit breaker: if 5xx_rate > 2% for 2m -> divert to fallback pool. Example autoscale snippet:```yaml
autoscale:
  pool: pool-A
  min: 2
  max: 8
  step: 1
  cooldown: 60s
  metrics: [latency_p95, queue_length]
```

alex_product: I'll sync with Tethys PM for traffic shape (gradual ramp vs. step-burst) and confirm who on their side will run canary. Also adding billing tags: customer:tethys, project:onboard-2026. Support coverage: need second-shift engineer on standby 08:00-14:00 PST. :white_check_mark:

miriam_cs: Added to the checklist. Who will run the k6 load script and where are we collecting metrics? @devon_ml?

devon_ml: I'll run k6 from two staging agents (us-west + eu-west). Script will ramp 0->1500 QPS over 10m, then 1500->6000 spike for 5m, then back to 1500 for 20m. Will push results to /console/metrics and upload raw k6 summary to the ticket. Quick script params:```bash
k6 run --vus 200 --duration 35m --out json=results.json loadscript.js
# loadscript will parameterize qps via options and ramping stages
```

pranav_sre: Also creating temporary alert channel #tethys-go-live. Alerts to include: p95_lat>350ms, error_rate>1%, gpu_util>95% per node. We'll mute non-critical noise during the spike.

opsbot: Reminder set — runbook review 30m before start. /remind @channel "Tethys bring-up runbook review" in 30 minutes.

miriam_cs: Legal asked that no logs be forwarded to third-party analytics during the run. Confirming: telemetry will be internal-only and PII redacted?

devon_ml: Confirmed. All telemetry goes to Redwood internal buckets with PII redaction. No external ingestion for this run.

alex_product: Post-load plan: 2h quiet window for stability checks, then QBR debrief with Tethys within 48h. I'll send calendar invite and ownership notes.

miriam_cs: Perfect. Final checklist: autoscale config (pranav) ✅, load script + results (devon) ✅, PM confirm traffic shape (alex) ✅, legal telemetry note ✅. See you all on the review 30m before. :rocket:
